lines.zh: 我贴着地面浮过去，尘土打旋。
lines.en: I drift over the ground, dust swirling.

lines.zh: 我不留脚印，只留一片凉。
lines.en: I leave no prints, only a patch of cold.

lines.zh: 我穿过草丛，草都朝我弯。
lines.en: I pass through grass and it bends toward me.

lines.zh: 我飘得很慢，像烟一样。
lines.en: I float slowly, like smoke.

lines.zh: 光从上面来，我往阴影里退。
lines.en: Light comes from above; I retreat into shadow.

lines.zh: 我在你身后飘着，没有声音。
lines.en: I drift behind you without a sound.

lines.zh: 我绕着石柱转，越转越深。
lines.en: I coil around a pillar, deeper each turn.

lines.zh: 我的边缘在吞掉周围的光。
lines.en: My edges swallow the light around me.

lines.zh: 我从门缝里挤进去，成了细线。
lines.en: I squeeze under the door as a thin thread.

lines.zh: 我离地半尺，飘过水面。
lines.en: I hover half a foot up and drift over water.

lines.zh: 有风想吹散我，我散开又聚拢。
lines.en: Wind tries to scatter me; I part and re-form.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙根滑，避开月光。
lines.en: I slide along the wall's base, avoiding moonlight.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，只是慢慢旋转。
lines.en: I hold still and simply rotate.

lines.zh: 尘埃在我里面转，出不去。
lines.en: Dust turns inside me and cannot leave.

lines.zh: 我听着远处的火把噼啪响。
lines.en: I listen to a distant torch crackling.

lines.zh: 我的中心很黑，看久了会晕。
lines.en: My center is black; stare too long and you reel.

lines.zh: 我在墙角积成一小团。
lines.en: I gather into a small clot in the corner.

lines.zh: 没有声音，我也不需要声音。
lines.en: There is no sound, and I need none.

lines.zh: 我的边缘一闪一闪，像在呼吸。
lines.en: My rim flickers as if breathing.

lines.zh: 我在这等了很久，不觉得久。
lines.en: I have waited long here and feel no time.

lines.zh: 有只虫子飞进来，没再出来。
lines.en: A bug flew in. It did not come out.

lines.zh: 我把光收进去，周围就更暗。
lines.en: I draw the light in, and it grows darker.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转，把地上的灰扫开。
lines.en: I turn slowly, sweeping ash from the floor.

lines.zh: 我想起一些不属于我的记忆。
lines.en: I recall memories that are not mine.

lines.zh: 我悬在梁下，看着门。
lines.en: I hang under the beam, watching the door.

lines.zh: 这一刻很静，我不介意。
lines.en: This moment is quiet. I do not mind.

lines.zh: 我等太阳落下去，才敢往门口飘。
lines.en: I wait for sunset before drifting to the door.

lines.zh: 墙上的影子比我先动。
lines.en: The shadow on the wall moves before I do.

lines.zh: 你站在光里，我在暗处看你。
lines.en: You stand in the light; I watch from the dark.

lines.zh: 我凑近一点，你还没发现。
lines.en: I come closer. You have not noticed.

lines.zh: 你的脸在我里面会很暗。
lines.en: Your face would look very dark inside me.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的眼睛，看它眨。
lines.en: I fix on your eyes and watch them blink.

lines.zh: 你举着火把，我被逼退半步。
lines.en: You raise a torch and I recede half a step.

lines.zh: 我歪了歪，像在点头。
lines.en: I tilt slightly, as if nodding.

lines.zh: 你的影子和我接上了。
lines.en: Your shadow has joined mine.

lines.zh: 我认出了你手里的骨头。
lines.en: I recognize the bone in your hand.

lines.zh: 你在找我，我就在这。
lines.en: You are looking for me. I am right here.

lines.zh: 我绕到你侧面，看你转身。
lines.en: I slip to your side and watch you turn.

lines.zh: 我不敢靠太近，白天还亮着。
lines.en: I dare not come closer. It is still day.

lines.zh: 你说话，声音穿过我。
lines.en: You speak, and your voice passes through me.

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，没有恶意。
lines.en: I have watched you a long while without malice.

lines.zh: 你看不到我，可你知道我在。
lines.en: You cannot see me, but you know I am here.

lines.zh: 你的剑穿过我，我散了一半。
lines.en: Your blade passes through and half of me scatters.

lines.zh: 那道光伤到我了，我退后。
lines.en: That light hurt me. I pull back.

lines.zh: 我被劈成两团，又勉强合上。
lines.en: Cut in two, I barely pull myself together.

lines.zh: 我的边缘缺了一块，漏着凉气。
lines.en: A piece of my edge is missing, leaking cold.

lines.zh: 疼这个字，我很久没用了。
lines.en: Pain is a word I have not used in a long time.

lines.zh: 火把燎过，我缩成一细条。
lines.en: The torch sweeps by and I thin to a thread.

lines.zh: 我散了又聚，聚得慢了些。
lines.en: I scatter and re-form, a little slower.

lines.zh: 你的骨头碰疼我了。
lines.en: Your bone struck me where it hurts.

lines.zh: 我快撑不住了，得躲进影里。
lines.en: I cannot hold much longer. Into the shadow.

lines.zh: 别以为这样就能灭掉我。
lines.en: Do not think that finishes me.

lines.zh: 你手里的骨头，让我发馋。
lines.en: That bone in your hand calls to me.

lines.zh: 你走进阴影，我就笑了。
lines.en: You step into the shade, and I am pleased.

lines.zh: 把火把放下，我们聊聊。
lines.en: Set the torch down. Let us talk.

lines.zh: 你的恐惧很香。
lines.en: Your fear has a good scent.

lines.zh: 这里太亮了，跟我来暗处。
lines.en: Too bright here. Come into the dark with me.

lines.zh: 那根骨头是骨柄的材料吧。
lines.en: That bone would make a handle, would it not.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上有黑魔法。
lines.en: I smell dark magic on you.

lines.zh: 再靠近一点，我保证不伤你。
lines.en: One step closer. I promise no harm.

lines.zh: 你把暗黑棒藏哪儿了。
lines.en: Where did you hide that dark rod.

lines.zh: 阴影够深，我就够近。
lines.en: The deeper the shadow, the closer I get.

lines.zh: 你走过我，衣角结了霜。
lines.en: You pass through me and frost forms on your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的火把，散了一下。
lines.en: I meet your torch and scatter briefly.

lines.zh: 我贴到你背上，凉得像水。
lines.en: I cling to your back, cold as water.

lines.zh: 风把我推向墙壁，我挤扁了。
lines.en: Wind presses me flat against the wall.

lines.zh: 你一挥手，我从中间断开又合上。
lines.en: Your swat splits me; I close again.

lines.zh: 我和另一团暗影撞上，混在一起。
lines.en: Another shade collides with me and we mingle.

lines.zh: 我卡在栅栏缝里，慢慢渗过去。
lines.en: Stuck at the fence gap, I seep through.

lines.zh: 我撞到水面，激起一圈冷雾。
lines.en: I strike the water and raise a ring of cold mist.

lines.zh: 你的武器划过我，我晃了晃。
lines.en: Your weapon cuts through me and I waver.

lines.zh: 我碰到光柱，边缘烧出白线。
lines.en: Touching a beam, my edge burns white.

lines.zh: 两团暗影绕在一起，成了更大的一团。
lines.en: Two shades coil and become a larger one.

lines.zh: 它旋转的方向和我相反。
lines.en: It spins opposite to me.

lines.zh: 我们交换了一点黑。
lines.en: We trade a little darkness.

lines.zh: 靠近时，我们的声音叠在一起。
lines.en: Close together, our voices overlap.

lines.zh: 我们分开又靠近，像潮水。
lines.en: We part and draw near, like tides.

lines.zh: 它记得的东西，我也记得了。
lines.en: What it remembers, I now remember.

lines.zh: 我们合了一会儿，又分开。
lines.en: We merge a while, then separate.

lines.zh: 这一片暗处，容得下我们两个。
lines.en: This patch of dark holds us both.

lines.zh: 我们一起转，尘埃绕成圈。
lines.en: We turn together and the dust rings out.

lines.zh: 它走了，我少了一半冷意。
lines.en: It leaves, and half my cold goes with it.

lines.zh: 我把那根骨头卷进来，收好。
lines.en: I draw that bone inside me and keep it.

lines.zh: 东西落进我里面，就不见了。
lines.en: What falls into me is never seen again.

lines.zh: 我带着一块黑石慢慢飘。
lines.en: I drift along carrying a black stone.

lines.zh: 我吞了你的箭，又吐出来。
lines.en: I swallow your arrow and spit it back.

lines.zh: 这点光，我先收着。
lines.en: This bit of light, I will hold for now.

lines.zh: 硬币在我里面打转。
lines.en: A coin turns inside me.

lines.zh: 我把掉的骨柄材料藏起来。
lines.en: I hide the fallen handle material.

lines.zh: 太重了，我托不住它。
lines.en: Too heavy. I cannot hold it up.

lines.zh: 我裹着那卷纸，字都黑了。
lines.en: I wrap that scroll, and its letters blacken.

lines.zh: 箭飞过来，我让它原路回去。
lines.en: The arrow comes; I send it back the way it came.

lines.zh: 你身上有光，我很不喜欢。
lines.en: You carry light, and I dislike it.

lines.zh: 那个举火把的，先解决他。
lines.en: The one with the torch goes first.

lines.zh: 我锁定了你的影子。
lines.en: I have claimed your shadow.

lines.zh: 有活物走进我的暗处了。
lines.en: Something living has entered my dark.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛会先看不见。
lines.en: Your eyes will go first.

lines.zh: 目标只有一个，别挡路。
lines.en: One target only. Do not block the way.

lines.zh: 谁打碎了这块黑，我就找谁。
lines.en: Whoever broke this darkness, I will find.

lines.zh: 我的弹已经对准你的眼睛。
lines.en: My bolt is already aimed at your eyes.

lines.zh: 那根骨头，我迟早会拿回来。
lines.en: That bone will come back to me eventually.

lines.zh: 你在光下，我等到日落。
lines.en: You are in the light. I will wait for sunset.

lines.zh: 我转向你，尘埃跟着转。
lines.en: I turn toward you and the dust turns with me.

lines.zh: 这一带只有你值得追。
lines.en: In this area, only you are worth following.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶转，等你抬头。
lines.en: I circle overhead, waiting for you to look up.

lines.zh: 我的魔法弹已经对准你的眼睛。
lines.en: My bolt is already aimed at your eyes.

lines.zh: 你退到暗处，正合我意。
lines.en: You retreat into the dark. Exactly right.

lines.zh: 我的光弹已经聚在中心。
lines.en: The bolt is gathering at my core.

lines.zh: 你挡着眼睛，我就从侧面来。
lines.en: You shield your eyes, so I come from the side.

lines.zh: 你换手拿火把的那一刻，我看见了。
lines.en: I saw the moment you switched hands with the torch.

lines.zh: 现在太亮，我动一下就会散。
lines.en: Too bright now; a move would scatter me.

lines.zh: 你的箭射不中我，我知道。
lines.en: Your arrows cannot hit me. I know this.

lines.zh: 我在等你眨眼的那一瞬。
lines.en: I am waiting for the instant you blink.

lines.zh: 咱们离得够近了。
lines.en: We are close enough now.

lines.zh: 我绕两圈，先把你的方向弄乱。
lines.en: Two circles first, to confuse your sense of direction.

lines.zh: 你听得见嗡声，却找不到我。
lines.en: You hear the hum but cannot place me.

lines.zh: 阴影移一寸，我就进一寸。
lines.en: Each inch the shadow moves, I take.

lines.zh: 我的光弹正中你的眼睛。
lines.en: My bolt strikes you square in the eyes.

lines.zh: 你眼前一黑，那是我给的。
lines.en: That darkness in your sight is my gift.

lines.zh: 我撞进你胸口，冷得刺骨。
lines.en: I drive into your chest, cold to the bone.

lines.zh: 光散了，你暂时看不见。
lines.en: The flare bursts; you cannot see for now.

lines.zh: 我不咬，我只熄灭你的光。
lines.en: I do not bite. I put out your light.

lines.zh: 这一下让你撞上墙。
lines.en: This one sends you into the wall.

lines.zh: 你的火把弱了，我更强。
lines.en: Your torch dims and I grow stronger.

lines.zh: 黑暗从你眼角爬进来。
lines.en: Darkness creeps in from the corner of your eye.

lines.zh: 你挥剑，剑砍在空处。
lines.en: You swing your sword through empty air.

lines.zh: 我退开，你的视线还没回来。
lines.en: I withdraw, and your sight has not returned.

lines.zh: 我从夜里凝出来，先看月亮。
lines.en: I condense out of the night and look at the moon first.

lines.zh: 这间屋子够暗，我留下了。
lines.en: This room is dark enough. I will stay.

lines.zh: 我一出现，火把就暗了一截。
lines.en: The moment I appear, the torch dims.

lines.zh: 我记不清自己从哪来。
lines.en: I cannot recall where I came from.

lines.zh: 有人在附近，我感觉得到。
lines.en: Someone is near. I can feel it.

lines.zh: 我先聚成一小团，再慢慢长大。
lines.en: I gather small first, then slowly grow.

lines.zh: 阳光在窗外，我不敢出去。
lines.en: Sunlight is outside the window. I dare not go.

lines.zh: 骨头的气味把我引来了。
lines.en: The smell of bone drew me here.

lines.zh: 这里死过人，我记得。
lines.en: Someone died here. I remember.

lines.zh: 我绕房间一圈，找阴影。
lines.en: I circle the room, looking for shadow.

lines.zh: 我一开口，声音像从井底来。
lines.en: When I speak, my voice comes from a well's bottom.

lines.zh: 尘灰落进我里面，成了我的身体。
lines.en: Dust settles into me and becomes my body.

lines.zh: 这一夜很长，够我做事。
lines.en: The night is long. Enough time to work.

lines.zh: 我等着有人吹灭那盏灯。
lines.en: I wait for someone to blow out that lamp.

lines.zh: 火焰舔过来，我的形体卷曲。
lines.en: Flame licks at me and my shape curls.

lines.zh: 我从梁上被震落，散了一地。
lines.en: Knocked off the beam, I spill across the floor.

lines.zh: 水把我压成薄薄一层。
lines.en: Water flattens me into a thin sheet.

lines.zh: 爆炸的光把我撕开了。
lines.en: The blast's light tears me apart.

lines.zh: 那支箭我本该弹回去的。
lines.en: That arrow was one I should have turned back.

lines.zh: 圣光刺进来，我整团发白。
lines.en: Holy light pierces in and I go white.

lines.zh: 太久没吞光，我稀薄得透明。
lines.en: Too long without light, I thin to transparent.

lines.zh: 雷光直劈下来，我几乎散了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes straight down and I nearly dissolve.

lines.zh: 这下面连暗都没有。
lines.en: Down here there is not even darkness.
